title.zh: 为 Cavite 市设立一名助理市检察官职位，并为此修订该市宪章第24条的法案
title.en: An Act Creating the Position of One Assistant City Fiscal for Cavite City, Amending for the Purpose Section Twenty-Four of the Charter of Said City
title.orig: An Act Creating the Position of One Assistant City Fiscal for Cavite City, Amending for the Purpose Section Twenty-Four of the Charter of Said City

text.en:
The first paragraph of Section twenty-four of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five hundred forty-seven, otherwise known as the Charter of the City of Cavite, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 24. The City fiscal—His assistant—His powers and duties. -The Law Department shall consist of the city fiscal who shall be the chief adviser of the city and one assistant city fiscal. The city fiscal shall receive a salary of not exceeding five thousand seven hundred pesos per annum and the assistant city fiscal, not exceeding five thousand one hundred pesos per annum. Said assistant city fiscal shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments. The city fiscal shall have the following powers and duties.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
